title: Building Scalable APIs with Node.js
summary: Learn how to build production-ready APIs with rate limiting, caching, and solid error handling patterns.
body: In this post, I walk through a practical structure for Node.js APIs that scales with traffic and team size.
We’ll cover rate limiting, request validation, error handling, and a few patterns that keep your codebase maintainable.
If you’re deploying on serverless (like Vercel), we’ll also discuss cold starts and where caching belongs.

title: TypeScript Generics Deep Dive
summary: A practical guide to generics with utility and conditional types — with examples you can reuse.
body: Generics help you write reusable, type-safe code without sacrificing inference.
We’ll build a few small utility types and show how to model API responses cleanly.
By the end, you’ll be comfortable reading and writing generic helpers in real projects.
